description_en: Queries the list of node groups under the current Alibaba Cloud account by calling ListNodeGroups
description_zh: 调用ListNodeGroups查询当前阿里云账号下的节点分组列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-node-groups --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --fuzzy-name test --fuzzy-join-eui d896e0 --fuzzy-dev-eui d896e0 --offset 0 --limit 2 --sorting-field CREATED_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodeGroups

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
